messages:
elena: Quick sync  product approved a gentle sunset for v1. We want minimal disruption: micro banners, staged redirects to /docs/v2/compat, and a very short migration checklist for SDK owners. Target staging 2026-04-15.

samir: ok. split tasks: banners+i18n, redirect rules + analytics tag, SDK gotchas (Go auth + JS param rename), ops checklist.

anya: i'll take banners and translations (en/fr/ja). microcopy only, under 120 chars. include exact phrase: "Planned deprecation: v1 API. Migrate to v2 by 2026-05-15." with CTA to /docs/v2/migrate.

michael: Go gotcha: some clients fail if Authorization header has stray whitespace or missing Bearer prefix. Suggest adding this snippet to auth section:
```
// Go: normalize Authorization header
req.Header.Set("Authorization", strings.TrimSpace("Bearer "+token))
resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
```

samir: add a tiny JS example too: `req.headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token.trim()}``. Also propose 302 with `?sunset=v1` for staging so analytics can track.

elena: ops wants exact nginx rule for staging and a small smoke checklist. propose rule:
```
location ~ ^/docs/v1/(.*)$ {
  return 302 /docs/v2/compat/$1?sunset=v1;
}
```

ops-bot: Created task OPS-7012: staged-docs-redirects (staging deploy 2026-04-08). Assigned to elena.

anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8123  banners + i18n.

michael: i'll open Go SDK PR with header trim + unit test and link docs PR in description. aiming for Monday.

samir: add PR checklist items: banners merged, auth note added, go-sdk test merged, staging nginx applied, smoke test old links redirect + banner visible, analytics `sunset=v1` observed 48h.

elena: i'll run the smoke tests and flip traffic per ops plan. update this thread when PRs merge. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: PRs merged: #8123 (banners). OPS-7012 scheduled for 2026-04-08 staging deploy.
